    fix(workflow): resolve judgment Stops by recorded Condition through one shared predicate (DEC-250)
    
    Each of the human-outcome-recorded and decision-satisfied Conditions now has
    exactly one qualifying-fact predicate in internal/workflow. Manual
    `stop resolve` and the atomic resolution inside human-outcome.recorded and
    decision.referenced call it, so the two paths cannot diverge, and resolution is
    keyed on the Stop's recorded Condition rather than its raising code: a
    producer's readiness Stop and an operator-stop carrying the Condition resolve
    identically. R2 requires class, approved result, no supersession (the
    evaluator's own predicate) and subject scope for envelope, run and activation
    subjects; R3 requires the pair-completing Event of a satisfied protected
    Decision, derived by the same code the guarded actions use. `stop raise`
    rejects decision-satisfied on an activation subject with no Event.
